span.label: mechanisms
span.term: WHY TRANSFER LEARNING EXISTS AT ALL: ordinary machine learning assumes train and test come from one domain with one distribution, and the method is what you do when that assumption is false and the target data is expensive to collect
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: NEGATIVE TRANSFER IS DEFINED BY COMPARISON, NOT BY DAMAGE: a learner trained on the target alone is compared against one trained with the source added, and transfer is negative when the plain learner wins
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: PSEUDO LABELS CORRECT A DISTRIBUTION USING GUESSES AT THE THING BEING CORRECTED FOR: with no labeled target data, labels are estimated and then used to fix the conditional distribution - which the paper itself calls problematic
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: instance transfer reweights source examples to correct MARGINAL distribution differences, and works best precisely when the CONDITIONAL distribution is already the same
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the two feature approaches differ in direction: one bends the source onto the target, the other maps both into a shared latent space
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: parameter transfer shares model parameters or combines multiple reweighted source learners into an ensemble for the target
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: source classifiers are weighted by how close their conditional distribution is to the target, summed, and used to manufacture pseudo labels for unlabelled target data
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE FIELD IS DECLARED TERMINOLOGICALLY INCONSISTENT AND THE PAPER SAYS SO IN ITS OWN VOICE: `Quotation withheld` A survey opening by stipulating the vocabulary because the literature has none.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SAME CONFIGURATION, RENAMED IN THE NEXT SENTENCE: `Quotation withheld.` The sentence immediately before it - quoted separately on this record - gives that exact configuration to Daume and Chattopadhyay as SUPERVISED. The full four-scheme enumeration spans several sentences with a journal running header splicing one of them, so it is carried across four tags on this record rather than asserted from one span.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE PAPER'S REPAIR IS TO REFUSE THE VOCABULARY ALTOGETHER: `Quotation withheld.` It does not pick a winner and does not coin a fifth term - it describes the configuration and drops the names. THE SAME MOVE CONSORT MADE IN 2010, replacing `intention to treat` with `a more explicit request for information` (schulz2010).
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE LITERATURE'S VOCABULARY IS INCONSISTENT AND THE PAPER SAYS SO: transfer learning and domain adaptation are used for similar processes, and the supervised / semi-supervised / unsupervised labels mean different things to different authors

span.label: transfer learning - the paper's response to its own finding: it refuses the contested labels entirely and states the data conditions each time instead of naming them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `supervised transfer learning` - DAUME AND CHATTOPADHYAY'S SENSE: `abundant labeled source data and LIMITED labeled target data`. Gong and Blitzer give that same configuration to SEMI-SUPERVISED, and Cook and Feuz call it INFORMED SUPERVISED.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `semi-supervised transfer learning` - GONG AND BLITZER'S SENSE: `abundant labeled source data and LIMITED labeled target data`. THAT IS THE CONFIGURATION Daume and Chattopadhyay CALL SUPERVISED - see senses[4] and the `daume` mechanism on this record, which quote their sentence. One name over two configurations and one configuration under two names, in consecutive sentences.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `supervised` / `unsupervised` - COOK AND FEUZ MOVE THE AXIS: the pair refers to `the presence or absence of labeled data IN THE SOURCE domain` and a SECOND pair, `informed` / `uninformed`, carries the target. Two orthogonal axes where the other schemes have one.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
